texts.zh:
大功告成了。今天，我们骄傲地向星系交出我们最伟大的成绩单：我们的超空间中继器网道与我们的亲密友邦[from.GetName]紧紧相连了起来。

在[root.GetName]各地都在举行盛大的庆典，一致宣布这个我们共同引以为豪的新网道。据说就在此刻，我们冰释一切前嫌；放下了一切傲慢与成见。我们期盼在未来的日子里能够继续共享这份骄傲和与豪情。通过亲密无间的协作，我们打破了曾经一度认为不可逾越的壁垒，开启了友谊、共荣的新时代。
texts.en:
It is done. Today, we present the galaxy with one of our grandest accomplishments yet: the joining of our Hyper Relay network with that of our friends, the [from.GetName].

Lavish ceremonies have been held throughout the [root.GetName], unanimously heralding this proud new link we share. It is said that for the moment, all petty jealousies have been forgotten; all apathies and indifferences cast aside. Blended with this sense of pride and ambition is a shared confidence in the days to come. Working side by side we have torn down a barrier we once thought insurmountable, ushering in a new age of mutual prosperity and friendship.

texts.zh:
今天，我们将自己深深铭刻在了星系无与伦比的辉煌历史当中。随着我们超空间中继器网道与[from.GetName]网道的全线贯通，我们的公民现在可以毫无阻碍地前往那些邻近的恒星系。

另一方面，[from.GetAdj]也热烈接纳我们[root.GetAdj]的影响力。相信用以塑造我们自己灿烂辉煌恒星系的文化也能让他们从中收益。
texts.en:
Today we have etched ourselves further into a record of unparalleled galactic splendor. With the linking of our Hyper Relay network to that of the [from.GetName], our citizens may now venture into those neighboring systems without let or hindrance.

The [from.GetAdj], in turn, now welcome the embrace of our rich [root.GetAdj] influence. They too shall benefit from the bounteous culture which defines our own, magnificent star systems.

texts.zh:
今天，对我们而言星系中的阻碍又少了一个，我们与[from.GetName]的合作已经取得了丰硕的成果。与我们相邻超空间中继网道中的最后一个链接已经上线，从此双方可以便捷地通过彼此的边境。

出现在我们面前的是通往未知的旅程，因为这一架构会带来的一切机遇与挑战对我们和[from.GetName]都是等同的。我们将拭目以待，我们的邻国是如何看待这个相互信任的象征。
texts.en:
The galaxy presents one less hurdle to us today, as our co-operative effort with the [from.GetName] has reached a fruitful conclusion. The last link in our adjoining Hyper Relay networks has been brought online, inviting both partners into rapid transit across our shared border.

What awaits us now is a journey into the unknown, for every aspect of this arrangement - positive or negative - applies equally to us and the [from.GetName]. We shall see how well our neighbors hold to this symbol of mutual trust.

label.zh: 这是值得所有人自豪的一天。

# 中继器网道 / Hyper Relay network

- 分类 Category：银河轶事 C8 stories · 来源 Sources：events/megastructure_events_1.txt, common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt · DLC：Overlord · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

on_capitals_connected（00_on_actions.txt:4913-4917）：两个首都通过超空间中继网络相连时，触发 over.100（THIS = 中继拥有者，FROM = 另一国）。
on_capitals_connected fires over.100 for the relay owner when two capitals are linked through a hyper relay network.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

单页通知，三个选项（均为确认类）。 Single notice with three acknowledging options.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 无后续事件。 No follow-up.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 正文按伦理/政体变体：非排外非威权非格式塔、威权或宗主（非格式塔）、格式塔或排外（megastructure_events_1.txt:4781-4816）。 Text varies by ethic/authority (three variants).

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：on_action 调用、事件三个正文变体与选项。 Checked the on_action, the three text variants and options.
